      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts</link>
      <description><p>Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts</p><p>The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.</p><p>The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party.       <description><p>Trump Media stock and WLFI coin saw declines but he is still $2.7bn wealthier than when he won election in 2024</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/04/midterm-election-results-question-answer">Send us your questions about the midterm results</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/nov/03/midterm-elections-full-results-senate-house-governor-races">Track live results from all 50 states</a></p></li></ul><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/donaldtrump">Donald Trump</a>’s wealth is falling along with his political fortunes.</p><p>Tradable investment assets that helped make the president more than $2bn during his first year in office are collapsing in value the day after the Democrats trounced the Republicans in the <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/us-midterm-elections-2026">midterm elections</a>. Trump Media and Technology Group stock, which trades on the Nasdaq exchange, was priced at just <a href="https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/DJT">over $5</a> on Wednesday morning – its lowest mark ever, and down from an all-time high of $101. It lost 11% overnight, dropping from $5.90 once the election returns started coming in. Trump has reported he owns 114m shares of DJT.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/04/trump-wealth-midterm-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Fox News suffers ratings slump on bleak election night for Republicans</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/media/2026/nov/04/fox-news-midterm-ratings</link>
      <description><p>In early, preliminary figures, the news channel trailed several other networks in prime-time viewership</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/04/midterm-election-results-question-answer">Send us your questions about the midterm results</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/nov/03/midterm-elections-full-results-senate-house-governor-races">Track live results from all 50 states</a></p></li></ul><p>On a midterm election night that was a huge disappointment for <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/republicans">Republicans</a>, with <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/democrats">Democrats</a> taking control of the US House and Senate, the country’s most prominent conservative television network felt the brunt of viewer disillusionment with <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/donaldtrump">Donald Trump</a> and his party, according to preliminary audience numbers.</p><p>The Fox News Channel, which often leads in viewership on election night, appears to have come out far behind the competition. According to preliminary “Fast Nationals” ratings dating from the Nielsen firm, the network averaged 3.882 million total viewers between 8 and 11pm, far behind broadcast networks NBC (6.519 million viewers) and ABC (4.906 million viewers), and even trailing fellow cable networks CNN (3.927 million viewers) and MS Now (3.922 million viewers). Fox News did, however, defeat CBS News, which attracted just 2.629 million viewers.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/media/2026/nov/04/fox-news-midterm-ratings">Continue reading...</a></description>
